title: Real Madrid beat Valencia to level Liga leaders Barca
text:

 AFP News Sat, 7 November 2026 at 10:05 pm UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Kylian Mbappe continued his fine goalscoring form as Real Madrid eased to a three-goal win against Valencia on Saturday (JOSE JORDAN) Kylian Mbappe scored for the seventh match running as Real Madrid pulled provisionally level on points with La Liga leaders Barcelona after a 3-0 win at 10-man Valencia on Saturday.
 Reigning champions Barca visit Atletico Madrid, third, on Sunday, aiming to move back clear of the chasing pack.
 Jose Mourinho's Madrid largely dominated at Mestalla stadium as they secured an eighth win in a row across all competitions.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Federico Valverde and Arda Guler's first half goals put Madrid in the driving seat and Mbappe added a third in the second half.
 Los Blancos were without winger Vinicius Junior, who was serving the final game of a four-match ban.
 Madrid have thrived in his absence, putting heavy pressure on Barca, whom they beat in the Camp Nou Clasico on October 25.
 In the ninth minutes the match stopped for players and fans to pay tribute to Tenerife striker Jesus de Miguel, who tragically died on Tuesday.
 Madrid goalkeeper Thibaut Courtois made a smart save to deny Aaron Mayol, who had picked Aurelien Tchouameni's pocket in a dangerous area.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Valencia's Guido Rodriguez had a goal disallowed for offside before Mourinho's side took control.
 Valverde drilled Madrid ahead from outside the area after Mbappe's free-kick was blocked by the Valencia wall and fell to the Uruguayan.
 Guler soon doubled the lead, after Jude Bellingham's cross was deflected kindly into his path.
 Guler had a good chance for the third in early in the second half but Valencia goalkeeper Stole Dimitrievski grabbed the ball as the midfielder tried to round him.
 Minutes later Dimitrievski saved well from Mbappe as the French striker ran through and tried to dink the ball over him.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Bellingham powered his way through the defence and was also denied by the goalkeeper, as was Mbappe following up with an overhead kick, as Madrid tried to find a third to kill off the game.
 Eventually Mbappe produced it, bursting onto a dangerous pass by Guler to dart past Dimitrievski and squeeze home his 13th league goal of the campaign.
 It was the forward's 17th goal in 16 games across all competitions. Mbappe has netted in his last seven appearances for Madrid.
 Valencia's Jose Gaya was dismissed with around 10 minutes remaining for a late sliding foul on Mbappe to further spoil Javier Aguirre's team's night.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Earlier new Espanyol coach Eder Sarabia's side were held to a goalless home draw by Deportivo La Coruna.
 Osasuna snatched a late 1-1 draw against Athletic Bilbao, while Racing Santander came from behind to beat Malaga 2-1.
